spans.s:
subst. mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
A belt or chain worn round a man's body.
2 A chain for confining an elephant.
3 A chain, a fetter in general.
E.
शृङ्ग a horn, here said to mean a link, and खल to collect, aff. अच्; or शिञ्जा the tinkling of a chain, and स्खल to go, aff. अच्, deriv. irr.

m. (-कः)
A young camel with wooden rings or clogs on his feet.
E.
शृङ्खल a chain, and कन् aff.

f. (-ता)
1 Connexion, concatenation.
2 Restraint.
E.
तल् added to शृङ्खल; also with त्व, शृङ्खलत्वं.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Bound, chained, fettered, captive.
E.
शृङ्खला a chain, इतच् aff.

n. (-ङ्गं)
1 A horn.
2 A mark, a sign.
3 The top of a mountain.
4 Sovereignty, mastership.
6 Dignity, elevation.
6 A fountain, an artificial one or jet d'eau.
7 A lotus.
8 Very sharp.
9 Minutely fine.
m. (-ङ्गः)
1 A medicinal root, commonly

Jīvaka.
2

A Muni so named.
f. (-ङ्गी)
1

Gold.
2

A fish, (Silurus Singio, HAM.)
3 A plant, (Betula.)
4 Ṛṣabha, a medicinal root, shaped like a bull's horn.
5 Another plant, a kind of Rhus, with an excrescence or gall in the bark, compared to a crab's horn.
E.
शॄ to injure, Uṇādi aff. गन्, and the vowel made short.

m. (-कः)
A medicinal root, commonly Jivaka.
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

f. (-ला)
A plant, a kind of Rhus, having an excrescence in the bark formed by an insect, which is compared in shape to the horn of a goat or a crab.
E.
शृङ्ग a horn, लच् aff.

n. (-रं)
Ginger.
E.
शृङ्ग a horn, and वेर body or shape; also with कन् added, शृङ्गवेरक.

n. (-टं)
A place where four roads meet.
m. (-टः)
1 An aquatic plant, (Trapa bispinosa.)
2 A shrub, (Ruellia or Barleria longifolia.)
E.
शृङ्ग a horn, अट to go or be, aff. अच्.

n. (-कं)
1 A place where four roads meet.
2 An aquatic plant, (Trapa bispinosa.)
2 A door.
m. (-कः)
A collection or mountain of three peaks.
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

m. (-रः)
1 Love, the passion or sentiment as an object of poetical description or dramatic representation.
2 Copulation, coition.
3 Marks made with red-lead on an elephant's head and trunk by way of ornament.
n. (-रं)
1

Cloves.
2

Redlead.
3

Fragrant powder for the dress or person.
4

Ginger.
5

Agallochum.
E.
शृङ्ग eminence, dignity, ऋ to go to or obtain, and अण् aff.; being the chief of the poetical Rasas; or शॄ to hurt, आरन् Uṇādi aff. with नुम्, and गुक् augments.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Horned, having a horn or crest.
E.
शृङ्ग, and आरकन् poss. aff.

n. (-णं)
Red-lead.
E.
शृङ्गार love, and भूषण adorning.

m. (-निः)
The deity of love or KĀMA.
E.
शृङ्गार the passion, and योनि origin.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Stained with red-lead, reddened.
2 Affected with passion.
E.
शृङ्गार, and इतच् aff.

mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि)
1 Feeling, or relating to the passion of love.
2 Stained with red lead.
m. (-री)
1 An empassioned lover.
2 Dress, decoration.
3 An elephant.
4 The betel-nut tree, (Areca faufel.)
E.
शृङ्गार love, इनि aff. of relation.

f. (-ङ्गिः)
A sort of sheat fish, (Silurus Singio, HAM.)
mn. (-ङ्गिः-ङ्गि)
Gold for ornaments: see शृङ्ग and शृङ्गी.

n. (-कं)
A sort of poison.
f. (-का)
A plant, (Betula.)
E.
शृङ्ग a fish, &c., कन् aff.

n. (-कं)
Gold for ornaments.
E.
शृङ्गि the same, and कनक gold.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Horned.
m. (-णः)
A ram.
E.
शृङ्ग a horn, इनन् aff.

mfn. (-ङ्गी-ङ्गिणी-ङ्गि)
1

Horned.
2

Crested, peaked.
m. (-ङ्गी)
1 An elephant.
2 A mountain.
3 A tree.
f. (-ङ्गिणी)
1 A cow.
2 Arabian jasmine.
3 Heart pea.
4 Katuki, a medicinal plant.
E.
शृङ्ग a horn, &c., इनि poss. aff.
